messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: Pager alert — unusual outbound S3 uploads from inference-logs-prod (spike 3x baseline). see logs: /alerts/2067899999

lina: ack oncall, I'm up. on local machine now, pulling details :eyes:

marc: pulling egress and S3 access logs for last 60m. starting with nginx access and our log-shipper audit. will post snippets if I find clear indicators.

marc: log snippet (sanitized):
```
2026-03-15T10:20:41Z inference-logger PUT /upload 200 bucket=public-archive key=inference/2026-03-15/abc.log api_key=sk_live_xxx... src_ip=45.33.12.99
2026-03-15T10:21:03Z inference-logger PUT /upload 200 bucket=public-archive key=inference/2026-03-15/def.log api_key=sk_live_xxx... src_ip=45.33.12.99
```

jamie: that looks like debug logging leaked keys in object metadata. possible exfil to an external bucket. treat as security incident.

lina: @marc @jamie agreed. create bridge and start mitigation. I'm opening incident bridge: https://incident.inc/BR-2067899999 (bridge pinned in #incidents).

lina: immediate actions: 1) block offending IPs at edge 2) rotate any exposed service keys 3) isolate and snapshot bucket contents for forensics 4) scrub public copies only after snapshot 5) prepare customer-impact assessment

devops-bot: running firewall block: fwctl block 45.33.12.99 -> queued

marc: fwctl returned: rule applied on all prod edges, propagation ~10s. observed incoming from 45.33.12.99 stopped at 10:25:12 UTC.

jamie: start key rotation now. list of suspected tokens: inference-logger, log-shipper, ci-s3-uploader. Rotate service tokens that have write perms to S3.

lina: marc, can you enumerate which tokens appear in logs and map to services? I want owners for each.

marc: found tokens in objects for two services: inference-logger (owner: sara) and log-shipper (owner: devops automation). I'm DMing owners and starting rotation via the admin API.

marc: rotation command (internal):
```
POST /admin/rotate-token {"service":"inference-logger"}
```
Response: 202 Accepted, new_token_id=rot-0a1b2c. Applying to deployments.

devops-bot: rollout started for inference-logger -> 6 pods, rolling env var swap. status: 2/6 updated (10:30 UTC).

lina: jamie — forensics first: we should snapshot the public-archive bucket to `forensics/BR-2067899999` (locked, KMS). DO NOT delete original until snapshot complete and legal confirms.

jamie: correct. @oliver legal, please confirm retention and any customer notification threshold.

oliver: Legal here. We need a preserved copy for 6 months in a locked bucket with restricted access. If any PII or customer API keys are present in objects, we need to prepare communications. Collect sample count and notify me asap.

marc: snapshot in progress: `aws s3 sync s3://public-archive s3://forensics-br-2067899999 --storage-class=STANDARD` started 10:33 UTC. ETA ~6m (bucket ~120MB).

lina: while snapshot runs — scrub immediate read ACLs on the public bucket and revoke any presigned URLs. marc, run bucket policy lock to private.

marc: ran: `aws s3api put-bucket-acl --bucket public-archive --acl private` -> success 10:35 UTC. Revoked presigned links by rotating pre-signed token signing key (internal).

devops-bot: rotation complete for inference-logger. 6/6 pods now using rot-0a1b2c. log-shipper rotation queued.

jamie: also run fast token scan across application logs to find any other leaked tokens. I kicked off a grep job across last 7 days with token regex. posting counts when done.

marc: grep job results (preliminary): 27 objects with token-like strings in metadata in the last 24h; top emitter: inference-logger.

lina: customer impact check: initial query of customer-facing endpoints shows no external requests correlated to these writes. appears internal logs only. keep monitoring.

jamie: still, treat as high risk — rotate any token that had write to S3 and invalidate old keys. Also rotate CI secrets if they have access to the same keys.

marc: started CI secret rotation for s3-uploader (10:39 UTC). will post completion.

sara: owner of inference-logger here. confirming we pushed a hotfix to stop including api_key in metadata (PR merged and deployed). Adding logging sanitizer to codebase.

lina: good. checklist update: sanitizer merged, token rotations in progress, bucket snapshot done?

marc: snapshot finished 10:40 UTC. forensics copy in s3://forensics-br-2067899999 (kms:key=arn:aws:kms:.../forensics-br-2067899999). Access restricted to sec+legal+forensics only.

oliver: confirmed preservation. legal retains access and will review sample objects. If PII found, we escalate to privacy team and draft notification.

jamie: scan finished: additional 3 tokens found in older archives; I've revoked older tokens and blacklisted their IDs. Sending automation report to #sec-ops.

lina: timeline (tentative):
- 10:20 UTC: suspicious uploads detected by pagerbot
- 10:22 UTC: first triage messages
- 10:25 UTC: blocked external IPs
- 10:30 UTC: rotation started for inference-logger
- 10:33 UTC: forensics snapshot started
- 10:40 UTC: snapshot complete, public bucket made private

lina: immediate customer impact: none confirmed. next steps: full token audit, postmortem, update runbook to prevent metadata leakage, follow-up communication if legal requires.

marc: I'll open a ticket for postmortem and remediation tasks including: input sanitizer release, S3 write permissions review, re-run token scanner weekly.

devops-bot: log-shipper rotation complete 10:45 UTC. CI rotation complete 10:48 UTC. All known write tokens rotated and invalidated.

jamie: forensics will start deeper analysis. if anyone finds evidence of read-side exfil (external pulls), ping here immediately.

lina: thanks team. keeping this thread pinned to the bridge. I'll close the incident in #incidents when forensics and postmortem ticket are created and legal signs off on comms.

pagerbot: alert resolved — no further upload activity from blocked IPs after 10:25 UTC.

lina: next immediate owner items assigned: marc -> postmortem ticket + remediation; sara -> PR to add sanitizer to all logging flows; jamie -> forensics lead; oliver -> legal review + comms decision.

lina: closing updates will be here. if anything new shows up, re-open thread or ping paging list. :white_check_mark:
